name: make_move
description: Place the user's X on the tic-tac-toe board. payload: {"square": 1-9}, 1 = top-left, 5 = center, 9 = bottom-right.

name: new_game
description: Clear the board and start a new tic-tac-toe game.

name: board_update
description: Sent by the app after every move (voice or click): {board, player_move, agent_move, result, source}. Briefly tell the user where the agent (O) moved and react if the game ended.
